task_types.name: Object detection
steps: Collect images and define the class list
Annotate bounding boxes in YOLO format
Train a YOLO baseline, then tune image size and augmentation
Evaluate mAP and review per-class false positives
Export the model and run it on video or behind an API

task_types.name: Segmentation
steps: Collect images and define mask classes
Annotate polygons or masks (bootstrap with SAM to save time)
Train U-Net, SegFormer or YOLO-seg
Evaluate mIoU and Dice per class
Turn masks into measurements, areas or GIS polygons

task_types.name: Classification
steps: Gather labeled images for each class
Split by source or patient to avoid data leakage
Fine-tune a pretrained backbone (EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT)
Evaluate F1, AUC and the confusion matrix
Add Grad-CAM to check what the model attends to

task_types.name: OCR & documents
steps: Collect document or text images
Detect, crop and rectify text regions
Train or fine-tune a recognizer (CRNN or transformer OCR)
Measure character and word error rates
Parse fields into structured output (JSON, CSV, Excel)

task_types.name: Tracking & video
steps: Record or source representative video
Run a detector on every frame
Link detections over time with ByteTrack or BoT-SORT
Evaluate HOTA, IDF1 and count accuracy
Add zones, counters, alerts and a dashboard

task_types.name: Pose & landmarks
steps: Capture video of the target movements
Extract keypoints with MediaPipe or YOLO-pose
Compute joint angles and temporal features
Classify or score the sequences
Test on unseen people and give real-time feedback

task_types.name: Restoration & generation
steps: Build paired or synthetically degraded training data
Start from a pretrained restoration or generative model
Fine-tune on your own domain
Evaluate PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS, plus a visual review
Ship a before/after comparison interface

task_types.name: 3D & depth
steps: Calibrate the camera or cameras
Capture images from known viewpoints
Estimate depth or reconstruct geometry
Compare against measured ground truth
Export point clouds, meshes or 3D coordinates

task_types.name: Embeddings & search
steps: Assemble a gallery of reference images
Compute embeddings (CLIP, DINOv2, ArcFace)
Index vectors with FAISS or a vector database
Evaluate Recall@K and pick match thresholds
Build the query interface

task_types.name: Vision-language
steps: Choose an open vision-language model
Design prompts and a fixed output format
Combine it with detection or OCR tools where needed
Evaluate on a hand-labeled question set
Add speech, safety checks and a latency budget
